tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind panes.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panes: header, outline, problem, editor, checks.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Current outline row (dark), secondary buttons, inline code chips, hint rows.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Pane borders, header divider, neutral tag fill in dark.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Example left rule, control borders, not-started rail segments.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on surface and bg.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Body copy, example values, done outline rows.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Meta text: breadcrumbs, timings, labels, not-started rows. 4.5:1 on surface in both themes.

tokens.name: text-faint
tokens.usage: Decorative only: editor line numbers, disabled arrows. Fails 4.5:1; never for meaningful text.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one brand accent as a FILL: primary button, logo tile, XP bar, current-lesson marker. Text on it uses accent-ink.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Accent as TEXT: streak count, +XP pill, tutor button. Light mode darkens it to pass 4.5:1 on white.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Behind accent-text: +XP pill, current outline row in light.

tokens.name: accent-line
tokens.usage: Dashed border of the tutor button; light primary button border.

tokens.name: progress-current
tokens.usage: Current-lesson segment in the outline rail; darker in light for 3:1 against white.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Passed checks, done lessons, Easy difficulty, expected values.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Behind success text: Easy pill.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Failed checks, wrong output values, error line number.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Error line highlight in the editor, failed check card.

tokens.name: level-bg
tokens.usage: Level badge fill: inverts against the page in both themes.

tokens.name: level-ink
tokens.usage: Level badge text.

tokens.name: code-keyword
tokens.usage: Editor: keywords (def, for, in, return).

tokens.name: code-function
tokens.usage: Editor: function names.

tokens.name: code-number
tokens.usage: Editor: numeric and constant literals.

tokens.name: medal-bronze
tokens.usage: Bronze medal fill, bronze tier pips and title chip. Game layer only.

tokens.name: medal-silver
tokens.usage: Silver medal fill and tier pips.

tokens.name: medal-gold
tokens.usage: Gold medal fill and tier pips. Distinct from accent: never use it for actions.

tokens.name: medal-diamond
tokens.usage: Diamond (rarest) medals and the Streak Freeze icon.

tokens.name: boss-hp
tokens.usage: Remaining boss HP segments; knocked-out segments use border.

styles.name: section
styles.usage: Example and Constraints headings, check summary.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Return the total of every integer in nums.

styles.name: code-sm
styles.usage: Examples, constraints, check rows, file tab.

styles.name: game-sm
styles.usage: Level badge, XP pill. Never for instructions or body text.
